experience.summary: Delivered 14 client projects end-to-end — scope, GDD, creative direction, development, and delivery — for mobile and web, collaborating with freelance artists and developers. Recruited and mentored junior developers, built Python tools for asset compression (TinyPNG API) and publishing prep, and implemented Phaser.js/HTML5 Canvas gameplay. CI/CD pipelines on GitHub & GitLab Actions cut deployment time by 40%, and custom Unity editor tools streamlined level testing, project setup, and batch lightmap/occlusion-map processing.

Led and scaled a team from 1 to 9 developers (12 at peak), owning hiring, onboarding, and mentorship alongside performance evaluations. Directed GDD creation and creative direction with clients across all Unity projects, ran Scrum ceremonies, and shipped Unity 2D, 3D, and AR (ARKit/ARCore) titles for Android and iOS — improving delivery speed by 30% through Agile workflow and tooling upgrades.

Hired and mentored junior developers with project-specific onboarding, and designed a reusable Phaser prototyping framework that let the studio produce 15+ games faster — still in active use today. Delivered six optimized Unity games with improved stability and performance, and improved retention through refined gameplay loops and reward balancing. Awarded Rookie Rockstar within the first two months for rapid, impactful contributions.

Developed 20+ 2D and 3D games across Unity, LibGDX, and Godot, reaching 1M+ downloads on Google Play and the Amazon App Store. Optimized performance for low-spec platforms like Roku and Amazon Fire TV, implemented monetization strategies (IAP, ads, cross-promotion) informed by ARPDAU/MAU analysis, and built backend systems and server-side applications for live game operations.
Assisted in web and software application development, participating in code review, debugging, and testing processes.
